value.rationale: Natural complete infinite-family Euclidean covariance classification of a canonical 0/1 graph polytope; sharp switch of least-variance eigenspace from the global all-ones line at balanced sizes to the smaller-part contrast space with dimension q-1 when unbalanced. The exact spectral conditioning changes from linear in balanced dimension to exponential as one partition grows. This is a structural and sampling-relevant dichotomy not obtained from face enumerations or John ellipsoids.
